IGUI_HUB_Intro: Open the windows of the HARMONIE mods from here. A window that needs something first says what to do.
IGUI_HUB_NeedVehicle: Stand next to a vehicle (or sit in one) first.
IGUI_HUB_NeedGun: Hold a gun in your main hand first (or right-click a gun > Inspect).
IGUI_HUB_GTP_Desc: Cooking recipes, vitamins, planting calendar and guide.
IGUI_HUB_TWA_Desc: Weapon crafting, materials, modifications and gem sockets.
IGUI_HUB_HM_Desc: Your own health: wounds, diagnosis, surgery and handbook. To examine someone else, right-click that player.
IGUI_HUB_SVU_Desc: Upgrades and part wear of the vehicle you are in or next to.
IGUI_HUB_MFS_Desc: Inspect and modify the gun in your hand.
IGUI_HUB_DebugGTP: Garden to Plate: vitamin admin panel
IGUI_HUB_DebugTWA: The Way To Attack: weapon in hand
IGUI_HUB_NotAdmin: Only admins or -debug can change these.
